summary: Wasco County lookout: a 20-foot pole L-4 tower and cabin built in the 1930s, state-owned from 1950, torn down and burned in fall 1956.

facts.design: 20-foot pole L-4 tower with a cabin
facts.status_note: Torn down and burned in fall 1956 per Rex's notes; the register lists removal in 1956 and firelookout.com lists it destroyed in 1956

events.note: State assumed ownership of Mill Creek Ridge and Postage Stamp stations, March 13, 1950, per a 1949 forest supervisor report quoted in Rex's notes
Torn down and burned in fall 1956 per a Barlow District report for 1956; register says removed 1956; firelookout.com says destroyed 1956

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the register and firelookout.com give only 'the 1930s' for the build, and no source read gives staffing, access or the site today. The Columbia Gorge News article on the Land Trust purchase returned HTTP 429 and was not read. Search snippets mention a 2016 Columbia Land Trust purchase on the ridge and a forum post placing the old lookout about 9 to 10 miles southwest of the trailhead; neither was read on the page, so neither is cited. Brief elevation_m 1040.6 not checked (a search snippet gives 3421 ft).
